author: independent loop-1 critic pair, education role (Claude subagent; did not author the blueprint), 2026-11-19; one agent performed both roles in sequence, so independence is from the author, not between the two roles. Reviewed 2026-11-19 against blueprint 2cc0b89a, course.json, the seven module labs (lab.json), module S13 notes, the final-mcq blueprint, and the STANDARD_FAST_PROMPT/SITREP final-day model. Objectives: all 30 resolve to existing topic.json objectives and are taught; formats are practical; the file carries no item or key material (no answer leakage); Boot 4.1.2/Java 25/offline H2 statements agree with the labs and the MCQ blueprint. Terminal for this loop: findings recorded OPEN; no recheck performed.

findings.claim: The practical calls itself Part 1 of the Spring course final on S13, but the programme rule is one 30-minute graded final per course (the 30-question MCQ), the Standard S13 day is already 119 of 120 minutes (review 14, lab 60, module check 45), and the programme final-day model (60+10+20+10+20 = 120 min) contains only the short 10+20 coding questions. A 150-minute sitting appears in no schedule, workbook row or Fast (FT8) treatment, and the blueprint only says it is platform-scheduled outside the frozen templates. It also overlaps in skills with the S13 module-check coding part (2 tasks) and the short Spring coding questions, which the 'no reused practice items' sentence does not cover. Honest disclosure, but its status (required component, optional, replaces nothing) is undecided.
findings.recommendation: Owner decision: state whether the 150-minute practical is a required part of the course final, where it is scheduled for Standard and Fast, and how it differs from the module-check coding part and the short Spring coding questions; then record it in the workbook binding.

findings.claim: 150 minutes for about 8 tasks covering 30 objectives has no recorded timing model. The seven module labs budget 278 task minutes plus 5-8 setup minutes each for 63 objectives; the practical samples 30 of them (about 48%) and is described as 'modestly harder' than the labs, which implies roughly 130-150 minutes before setup, the first mvn -o run, and any decision cost. No learner timing exists.
findings.recommendation: Record a per-task estimate (or the owner's explicit acceptance of one) before release, or reduce tasks/objectives; keep the claim 'estimate, not learner-timed'.

findings.claim: passMark 70 is stated for this part alone and weights is empty, so 70% of what (equal tasks, hidden-test points, partial credit) is not stated. Known owner decision on per-part 70% pass marks; noted, not blocking.
findings.recommendation: Owner to fix the per-part rule and the scoring basis; keep the blueprint value-free.

findings.claim: The id spring-boot-final-assessment now names only the practical (kind gradedPractical) while spring-boot-final-mcq is the other part; the id suggests the whole final. Known owner decision to rename to final-practical; kept so module notes resolve. Noted, not blocking.
findings.recommendation: If renamed, update course.json, the module notes and the evidence paths together.
